# Still Out There — Scene 03 Asset Pack

This ZIP contains the supplied Scene 03 screenshot and extracted visual assets.

## Included files
- `00_Original_Scene_Reference.png` — original screenshot, unchanged.
- `01_Child_Astronaut_Transparent_APPROX.png` — approximate transparent child cutout.
- `02_Oppy_Rover_Transparent_APPROX.png` — approximate transparent rover cutout.
- `03_Mars_Landscape_Background_Reference.png` — Mars environment crop.
- `04_Story_Parchment_Panel_Crop.png` — main story parchment panel.
- `05_Story_Title_Crop.png` — scene title crop.
- `06_Mission_Timeline_Crop.png` — 90 Martian days / approximately 15 Earth years timeline crop.
- `07_Mission_Card_Crop.png` — mission card crop.
- `08_Continue_Journey_Button_Crop.png` — continue button crop.
- `09_Top_Progress_And_Navigation_Crop.png` — progress and navigation crop.
- `10_Case_Title_Header_Crop.png` — case header crop.
- `11_Mars_Postcard_Crop.png` — small Mars postcard crop.
- `12_Child_Pointing_Gesture_Crop.png` — child gesture detail crop.
- `13_Rover_Mission_Illustration_Crop.png` — rover illustration crop.

## Important limitation
The source is a flattened screenshot, not a layered design file. The child and rover transparent PNGs are approximate automatic extractions and may contain small background fragments or lose fine details. Other elements are rectangular crops and may include overlapping pixels.

For the working website, rebuild all text, buttons, timeline labels, cards, and navigation in React/CSS. Use these crops as references, and preserve the original child, Oppy, colors, proportions, and illustration style. Avoid using the entire screenshot as a single background.
